verdict.rationale: Convex documents running its open-source backend on your own servers, using the same code as the cloud service, and the GitHub repo notes SQLite support, so running the backend yourself is a first-party capability. The CLI workflow (`npx convex dev`-style file watching, `npx convex run`) is evidenced only against a dev deployment, not a local emulator. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a local-machine backend or emulator mode for pre-deploy development, evidence that the full stack (auth, vector search, components) runs locally, and hands-on corroboration.
